claimBoundary: Runtime execution over installed local toolchains for one selected clamp/guard fixture only; it compares generated C, C++, Rust, Python, JavaScript, and Java outputs to a deterministic reference grid and makes no all-free-target runtime execution, public readiness, compiler correctness, formal equivalence, publication, runtime performance, hardware, Pro-target, or all-target readiness claim.
nonClaims: FEF-P35 records runtime execution for installed toolchains over one selected clamp/guard fixture.
FEF-P35 does not execute all 13 free targets.
FEF-P35 does not claim arbitrary branch/control-flow support.
FEF-P35 does not claim all free targets are public-ready.
FEF-P35 does not claim compiler correctness or formal semantic equivalence.
FEF-P35 does not publish a package, enable checkout, or claim production readiness.
FEF-P35 does not claim runtime performance, Verilog, silicon, hardware, Pro-target, or all-target readiness.
reviewHighlights: Generated C, C++, Rust, Python, JavaScript, and Java clamp_guard_mix targets execute locally.
All selected runtime targets match the deterministic clamp reference over seven samples.
Go, Kotlin, C#, MATLAB, wasm, Lean, and zkproof are not runtime-executed by this guard.
The guard is selected runtime evidence only and does not publish or widen public preview claims.
title: FEF-P35 Clamp/Guard Runtime Execution
